name: HRC_TXN_HEADER_ARCHIVE
description: Transaction Model Archive table: contain the archives of changes being made in this transaction

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Primary Key and unique identifier

columns.name: IS_TXN_GETTING_PURGED
columns.description: Flag to indicate if archived transaction is a candidate for getting purged.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_STEP_NUMBER
columns.description: This records sequence number within the archived transaction

columns.name: INITIATOR_USER_ID
columns.description: The user_id of the user who initiated the transaction

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the Application that set up the business data for this transaction

columns.name: MODULE_GROUP
columns.description: The Module Group of the module that set up the business data

columns.name: MODULE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The Module that set up the business data

columns.name: PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HRC_ARM_PROCESS_B

columns.name: OBJECT
columns.description: The main database table which will be updated by this transaction

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The primary key of the record to be updated on the REFERENCE_TABLE

columns.name: SUBJECT
columns.description: The type of the business object being worked on by this transaction, e.g. PERSON

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the business object being worked on by this transaction, e.g. PERSON_ID

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Connection to the parent transaction record on this table

columns.name: REENTRY_FUNCTION
columns.description: This column is used to store the Reentry function.

columns.name: PROCESS_OWNER
columns.description: Composite Process this transaction is part of

columns.name: SECTION_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display Name of the action being performed

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the transaction record was archived.

columns.name: XML_DATA_CACHE
columns.description: The transaction business data and context, as XML

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: High level grouping used in TAC searches
